title: CQ-RF: Protected runtime follow-ups
epicRails: Use original Moe source; the daemon owns state and the wrappers own host Git writes. Never directly edit .moe. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. The strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass.
Every task owns tests; exactly one final integration/hardening task per epic. Shared schema/protocol changes get broad regression.
Preserve legacy policy. No unsupported isolation downgrade or caller-minted trusted evidence.
Parallelize only file-disjoint implementations. Serialize overlapping affectedFiles through explicit dependencies; preserve peer/pre-existing bytes. No Git writes outside wrappers.
Protected-profile state persisted by these rows lives outside the repository, with owner-only access. A missing, unreadable or mismatched record always fails closed to today's refusal.
